lines.text: Many learners say: I took a good score on the test.
Better: I got a good score on the test.
Got! I got a good score on the test.

en.caption: Do you say this? “I took a good score on the test.” 😅 Do not use took for a score. The natural way is “I got a good score on the test.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
